data.name: Adheesh
data.gender_notes: Adheesh is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Adheesh is recorded with the meaning “God of Gods”. Adheesh is a Hindu name meaning “God of Gods”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Adheesh expresses “God of Gods”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

in_sanskrit.name: अधीश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who rules over or has mastery over something

in_hindi.name: अधीश
in_hindi.long_meaning: पति (husband) या स्वामी (lord, master) या वासिक (resident, inhabitant)

in_tamil.name: அதீஷ
in_tamil.meaning: அதன் அதிகாரி, அதன் அடிக்கலைகள், அதன் வழிபாடுகள்
in_tamil.long_meaning: அதன் அதிகாரி (ruler, king) யாவர்கள், அதன் அடிக்கலைகள் (subjects) யாவர்கள், அதன் வழிபாடுகள் (pathways, means)

in_telugu.name: అధీశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: ఆదేశ (lord, master, king) ఆధి (ruler) ఆధిపతి (chief, head)

in_marathi.name: Adheesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Adheesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who holds the universe in his hands

in_bengali.name: Adheesh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Gods
